correctness.rationale: The stationary same-active-run overlap gives C_W(s)=v^2 exp(-|s|)/2 independent of copula. Exponential renewal arguments justify cumulant growth as derivatives of the unique analytic root of E exp(-lambda T)cosh(kvU)=1; an explicit fourth-order Taylor expansion yields the raw-moment coefficient. The mixed exponential-logarithm beta integrals, zeta constants, strict rational sign certificate, and linear threshold were independently checked by exact or high-precision assertions in the packaged CHECK.py. Boundary and stationarity limitations are stated.

originality.rationale: The evaluated counterexample is not the generic renewal equation: its two exactly matched exponential marginals and *entire* velocity covariance/mean-square displacement coexist with opposite long-time fourth cumulant signs, with a rigorously evaluated zeta(3) copula threshold. Datta 2024 and Santra et al. 2024 construct independent phase-duration transport laws; no direct parameter choice there gives correlated within-cycle times. Niemann and Kantz 2008 address dependent jump/wait CTRWs broadly, so they are acknowledged and priority uncertainty is retained, but the accessible description does not establish this exact isocovariant sign reversal.

value.rationale: Active/rest dependence naturally arises in run-trap intermittent motion. This construction proves second-order indistinguishability at every observation lag while the leading non-Gaussian asymptotic coefficient crosses a unique exactly calculated threshold; different dependences become identifiable only through higher-order transport information. This is a structural observation-equivalence boundary and motivated exact classification, not merely a parameter substitution.
